subject: CSA evidence reclassification + API key audit for Helium Finance
messages:
From: Jack Smith <jack.smith@heliumfinance.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@thirdwing-audit.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CSA evidence and API key question

Hi Jordan —

We're kicking off our CSA (CAIQ) review next week and had two quick asks so we can finalize the evidence bundle for the auditor team: 1) a short mapping that ties Redwood artifacts to CSA control IDs, and 2) confirmation whether any legacy service accounts or API keys in the tenant are considered in-scope or if they should be listed as out-of-scope with a compensating control.

During our pre-scan the auditors flagged a few API keys tied to older monitoring integrations (keys created 2019-2020). Can you confirm whether Redwood has rotation logs or an approved decommission plan for those? If possible, we need the rotation log or an attestation before the audit window (target: 2028-04-07).

Deliverables we need if available:
- CSA control mapping (control ID -> artifact/location)
- API key rotation log or decommission timeline
- Owner for any legacy service account that will be documented as in-scope/out-of-scope

Thanks — appreciate a quick reply so we can scope the auditor request.

Jack
Director, Security
Helium Finance

-----
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Jack Smith <jack.smith@heliumfinance.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Mar 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CSA evidence and API key question

Hi Jack — thanks for the heads-up.

Summary of our plan:
- Kimberly will push an updated CSA control matrix that maps current artifacts and Drive locations (expected by EOD tomorrow).
- We will run a targeted API key audit against the monitoring integrations and provide a rotation/decom status. If keys are still active and unrotated, we will schedule rotation and provide the log slice.
- For legacy service accounts we will either: (A) document them as in-scope with a compensating control (short-term restriction + monitoring) or (B) note as out-of-scope with an owner and mitigation timeline. We'll confirm owner assignments in this thread.

Proposed timeline:
- 2028-03-30: initial CSA matrix and owner assignments (Kimberly)
- 2028-03-31: API key rotation log + artifact upload (Priyom)
- 2028-04-03: final attestation bundle delivered to Helium (Jordan / Marissa)

Jack — does that timeline work for your audit window? If you'd prefer the attestation earlier we can accelerate the rotation task.

Jordan Blake
Head of Security Programs
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>

Subject: CSA control matrix (v2) + initial owner mapping

Hi all — attaching csa_control_matrix-v2.xlsx (stubbed attachment). Notes below.

Attachment: csa_control_matrix-v2.xlsx (Excel, 72 KB)

Key highlights from the matrix:
- Mapped controls: Each worksheet maps CSA control ID -> Redwood artifact name -> Drive path -> evidence type (log, runbook, screenshot).
- API keys / service accounts: Controls AEC-3, IAM-5, KVM-2 referenced legacy monitoring service accounts. We identified three keys created before 2021 that are still active. Those are tagged in column G as "legacy-monitoring-2019" and flagged for owner confirmation.
- Proposed owner assignments:
  - legacy-monitoring-2019: Priyom Das (Platform Security)
  - autoscaler-service-account: Marissa Cole (Infra Ops)
  - runtime-audit-collector: Jordan Blake (Security Programs)

Quick remediation playbook for legacy keys (short):
1) Validate whether the key is attached to any running CI/CD job or external partner.
2) If unused, rotate & revoke, then publish rotation log.
3) If used, create replacement key, update integration, and rotate old key with 48-hour grace followed by revocation.

I gave each control a confidence rating in column J (high/medium/low) based on available artifacts. Low-confidence controls are highlighted; we'll need manual evidence pulls for those.

Kimberly Park
Sr. Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
